title: Instagram Thud
blurb: Weighty, low, slightly percussive: Instagram's alert is one of the few with actual bass in it. That thud-tap carries strange gravity for such a small event. Something happened, someone reacted, and the algorithm has news it considers urgent. A billion thumbs know it without thinking. Use it in edits about posting, going viral, or watching a like count move in real time. Better still, play it aloud in a shared space and enjoy the synchronised phone check that follows. Social media has a heartbeat, and this is roughly what it sounds like.
